A normal test or a common diagnosis does not clear an occupational exposure. Treat and notify as the exposure requires.  Do not send him home, to theatre, or back to the same unprotected job on the ordinary label.  The specific pathway starts now.  Waiting for a confirmatory test does not delay the first correct step.
